headline: Health Crisis: 196 more dengue patients hospitalized in 24 hours
summary: Dengue admissions surge as total cases cross 7,000. Meanwhile, a measles outbreak continues to claim lives, with 742 deaths reported.
details: A total of 196 new dengue patients were admitted to hospitals within the last 24 hours, according to recent health reports.
The overall number of dengue cases in the country has now surpassed 7,000, indicating a significant rise in the spread of the virus.
Simultaneously, the country is battling a measles outbreak, which has become increasingly severe.
The measles death toll has reached 742, with one child dying in the last 24 hours alone.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation as hospitals deal with the increasing influx of patients for both diseases.

headline: 2 Jubo League men on remand over cocktail blast at NCP rally
summary: A court has granted a two-day remand for two accused individuals following a cocktail explosion at a National Citizen Party rally in Savar.
details: A Dhaka Judicial Magistrate court has granted a two-day remand for two accused individuals in connection with a cocktail explosion at a National Citizen Party (NCP) rally in Savar.
The order was issued on Tuesday by Dhaka Judicial Magistrate Tajul Islam Sohag.
The accused have been identified as former Jubo League leader Md. Nurul Islam, 52, and Jubo League activist Md. Sajib, 32.
The incident occurred during the 'July March' rally organized by the NCP.
The investigation officer, Savar Police Station SI Md. Shakhawat Imtiaz, had initially requested a seven-day remand for the suspects.
Defense lawyers requested the cancellation of the remand and sought bail for the accused, while the state prosecutor pushed for the remand to continue the investigation.
caption:
Two Jubo League members are in custody following a cocktail blast at a National Citizen Party rally.

A Dhaka Judicial Magistrate court has granted a two-day remand for two accused individuals in connection with a cocktail explosion at a National Citizen Party (NCP) rally in Savar.

The order was issued on Tuesday by Dhaka Judicial Magistrate Tajul Islam Sohag.

The accused have been identified as former Jubo League leader Md. Nurul Islam, 52, and Jubo League activist Md. Sajib, 32.

The incident occurred during the 'July March' rally organized by the NCP.

The investigation officer, Savar Police Station SI Md. Shakhawat Imtiaz, had initially requested a seven-day remand for the suspects.

Defense lawyers requested the cancellation of the remand and sought bail for the accused, while the state prosecutor pushed for the remand to continue the investigation.

#Bangladesh #Savar #Politics #CrimeNews #JuboLeague

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, Prothom Alo
